We are Origin 13, a communications team based in Ethiopia. We make films, photographs, designs and campaigns that help you share your work with the people you want to reach.
We are a communications team based in Addis Ababa. We make films, take photographs, cover events and help organizations with design and campaigns.

For more than 12 years our team has worked across Ethiopia, Kenya, Somalia, Djibouti and South Sudan — in laboratories, rural communities, courtrooms and highland farms.

We believe the people in front of the lens deserve the same respect as the institutions behind the project. That is why we spend time before we film, ask before we photograph, and stay long enough to understand.

We make films and photographs that show the work clearly and treat people with respect.

Abbro — Making online shopping feel safe.

For many shoppers in Addis Ababa, buying online still feels uncertain. Abbro needed an identity that felt modern and energetic enough to stand out on a phone screen, yet warm and dependable enough to earn first-time trust.

The symbol shows two figures joined by a single line — a buyer and a seller, linked. Set inside a rounded yellow square, it reads clearly as an app icon. A friendly, rounded lowercase wordmark keeps the brand approachable and easy to say.

A bright signal yellow carries the brand’s optimism and is used for anything that invites action. Deep black brings confidence and clarity, while white and kraft keep the system calm and practical across screens and packaging.

Abbro is a custom typeface drawn for the brand: heavy, even strokes, soft circular bowls and rounded lowercase shapes that feel friendly and confident. Made only for Abbro, it gives the name a voice no other shop can borrow, and stays legible from an app icon to the side of a van.

The connecting line from the symbol extends into a network pattern of dots and links — every node a person, every line a delivery. It wraps tissue paper, mailers and social posts, so the idea of “together” travels with every order.
Macha Studios — Quiet in a loud market.
Wedding photography is crowded with ornate, glossy branding. Macha needed to feel premium and editorial without decoration — a brand that steps back, so the couple’s real moments can lead.
Macha Studios — The frame as a promise.

The symbol is a single open frame with one softened corner — a viewfinder, a photograph and an album at once. The gap in the line stands for moments that are never staged. Clean capitals give the wordmark a calm, timeless confidence.
A restrained palette of warm ivory and deep charcoal recalls fine-art paper and darkroom prints. Soft linen and a muted stone grey add texture, letting the photographs bring all the colour.
Montserrat in spaced capitals gives headings the feel of a gallery title card, while its lighter weights keep captions, letters and invoices quiet and elegant.

Nursery propagation and community food security

Inside community-managed highland greenhouses, a worker sprays a fine mist across nursery beds as others carry trays of young seedlings. Origin 13 documented this vital chain of food security and smallholder climate resilience for the Global Food Banking Network.
Captured on prime cinema optics in morning mist and diffused skylight. No staging — only the quiet cadence of agricultural stewardship.
Food sovereignty begins in the quiet dedication of the nursery. Honoring the people who nurture life from soil requires unhurried observation.
Continental genomic surveillance and African scientific leadership

Inside the laboratories powering continental disease surveillance, African scientists and technicians maintain the standards that protect millions. A film that shifts the narrative from vulnerability to leadership.
Filmed inside high-containment laboratories with sterile optical housings and minimal-footprint cinema kits.
Visual evidence that shifts the narrative from vulnerability to African scientific leadership.
Malaria prevention and the dignity of the household
A single shaft of light, a mosquito net raised at dusk. A quiet study of the everyday rituals that stand between families and preventable disease.
Available light only. Shot with a fast prime to preserve the darkness of the room and the privacy of the subject.
Health diplomacy succeeds when evidence centers the household, not the statistic.
